**Scheduling decisions differ** from `boosted-preempted`: preemptions 0 → 1, requeues 0 → 1, admissions 1 → 2; base capture ends after `second-pending`.

| 3 | `pending-reserved` ≠ | — (capture ended) | admit wl-pending · requeue wl-admitted · pending wl-admitted |
